Concretely, raven is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any pigment approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
